model_annotation: The diagram compares the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four industries: construction, trade, other services, and industry in 2021. There are three donut charts, each representing a different metric: number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover. The charts are divided into four sectors: construction (blue), trade (red), other services (gold), and industry (dark gold). The number of enterprises chart shows that other services account for 61% (19.0 million), construction for 19% (5.9 million), trade for 12% (3.7 million), and industry for 8% (2.4 million). The number of persons employed chart shows that other services account for 51% (80.2 million), trade for 21% (33.0 million), industry for 19% (29.5 million), and construction for 9% (13.4 million). The turnover chart shows that industry accounts for 33% (10.6 trillion), other services for 31% (9.8 trillion), trade for 31% (9.9 trillion), and construction for 6% (1.9 trillion). A legend at the bottom of the image clarifies the color coding for each sector. The charts are labeled with percentage values and absolute numbers, and the data is sourced from Eurostat.
